author: Good Enough
description:
For years, Krubera Cave, also known as Voronya Cave, held the title of the deepest cave on Earth, plunging more than 2,197 meters (7,208 feet) into total darkness beneath the Caucasus Mountains.

Reaching the bottom isn’t a single climb, it takes days of vertical rope descents, freezing water crossings, narrow passages, and extreme physical endurance. Deep sections of the cave are prone to flooding, and once you’re thousands of feet underground, there’s no quick way out.

Would you make it to the bottom?
